# ClearEdge Protective Films

## About
ClearEdge Protective Films is Kennesaw, Georgia's premier installer of paint protection film (PPF), ceramic coating, and window tint. We serve the greater Atlanta area including Marietta, Acworth, and Canton. All installations are performed by certified technicians in a climate-controlled facility with a 10-year manufacturer warranty on PPF.

## Services
- Paint Protection Film (PPF): Self-healing urethane film protecting paint from rock chips, road debris, and scratches. Packages: Partial Front, Full Front, Full Front + Lower Sides, Full Body.
- Ceramic Coating: Permanent hydrophobic shield that repels water, dirt, and UV rays with a deep glossy finish.
- Window Tint: Premium ceramic window film blocking 99% of UV rays with significant heat reduction.

## FAQ
- Is PPF worth it? For most car owners, yes. PPF preserves your paint's condition and protects your vehicle's resale value. A full-front install can pay for itself the first time a rock chip doesn't ruin your hood.
- How long does PPF installation take? Partial front installs take approximately 1 day. Full front takes 1-2 days. Full body installs typically take 3-5 days depending on the vehicle's complexity.
- Does PPF look visible on my car? Modern PPF is nearly invisible when professionally installed. Matte/stealth film is also available if you want to change your finish.
- What are the downsides of PPF? PPF is an investment. Full-body installs start in the thousands. Film edges can be visible on certain panel shapes. Removal should always be done professionally.
- Can I combine PPF with ceramic coating? Absolutely. PPF handles the physical protection while ceramic coating goes on top for hydrophobic properties and an enhanced gloss. The combo is the gold standard for vehicle protection.

## Installation Process
1. Free Consultation: Assess vehicle, discuss coverage goals, recommend the right package.
2. Paint Inspection: Inspect and document paint condition before beginning.
3. Decontamination Wash: Full decontamination wash and clay bar treatment.
4. Custom Film Cutting: Computer-cut to exact vehicle template for precise fit.
5. Professional Installation: Certified technicians install in climate-controlled facility.
6. Final Walkthrough: Review completed install, provide aftercare instructions and warranty card.
